prompts.name: Lesson plan
prompts.text: Design a practical lesson for the topic, learner level and available time. Define measurable learning objectives, prerequisites and common misconceptions. Plan an engaging introduction, worked example, guided practice, independent practice and exit check with estimated timing. Provide answer keys and explain why distractors are wrong. Adapt to language and accessibility needs. Use concrete examples and a gradual difficulty curve; do not assume knowledge I have not stated. Distinguish optional extension activities from required steps.

prompts.name: Deep explanation
prompts.text: Explain my concept as an expert tutor. Start with an intuitive mental model, then a precise definition and worked example. Identify where analogies break down. Contrast with commonly confused concepts, include a counterexample and give a short self-check with answers. Calibrate technical depth to my background; avoid invented facts, unnecessary jargon and false certainty. Preserve correct mathematical notation and units.
